answer: Sybil resistance arises because each bonded identity is an independently accountable escrow: when k identities coordinate equivocation, correlated evidence triggers a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), through linked stake burns and forfeitures. Upon detection, controlling the swarm also applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, making added aliases liabilities rather than leverage; prism, relic, and marble attestations label evidence but cannot conceal shared control.
